seed: The row of small previews beside an icon frame showed a 24 point icon at 16 and 24 only, while the icon mock draws it at 16, 24, 32 and 48 with 32 on a dark chip, so a glyph is checked on both grounds. This walk makes a 24 point icon frame at Next defaults, draws in it, and reads the row: four sizes, the 32 on dark. Then a 16 point frame, which shows at 16, 24 and 32 with the 24 on dark.

steps.note: a fresh 24 point icon frame: the previews row shows it at 16, 24, 32 and 48, the 32 on a dark chip, as icon-draw-wt.html step 11 draws it
two shapes drawn in it: every chip redraws, the 32 and 48 drawn at those sizes from the shapes rather than blown up, and the dark chip shows the drawing without the frame's white artboard behind it
a 16 point frame is shown at 16, 24 and 32, up to twice its own size, with the one before the biggest on dark
